scope: Corollary 1.3 (A parabolic region with trivial correction) of the manuscript “Prescribed large-volume charges on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle” (preprints/Prescribed-large-volume-charges-on-threefolds-with-trivial-canonical-bundle-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ce978a67015704), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every polarized smooth projective threefold (X, H) there is R∗ > 0 such that, if α > f(β) := β2 + R2 ∗ 2 , then Qα,β(vH(E)) ≥ 0 for every nonzero semistable object in BH,βH for the slope v2 − βv1 + (β2 − α)v0 v1 − βv0 , vH(E) = (H3 ch0(E), H2 ch1(E), H ch2(E), ch3(E)), again interpreted as +∞ at zero denominator.
